name: 90014 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90014 (Los Angeles) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90014 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90014 (Los Angeles) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
